rebuttal_or_critique: The committee remains divided on the stance, but there is a clear consensus on maintaining the repo rate at 6.50%. While I acknowledge the concerns regarding the 7.44% headline inflation, the moderation of core inflation to 4.90% provides a degree of comfort that the current spike is largely supply-driven. A shift to a neutral stance at this juncture, as suggested by Prof. Varma, would send an incorrect signal to the markets when inflation is significantly above our target. I remain firm on the 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance to ensure that we do not prematurely signal an end to our inflation-fighting resolve, especially given the 5.0% monsoon deficit and the need to manage liquidity surplus.
